# ======== 【核心修复区】 ========
# 1. 彻底屏蔽所有警告！防止 WebR 触发 translations 翻译包从而导致 Status 0 崩溃
options(warn = -1) 

# 环境设置：强制关闭可能导致 WebR 崩溃的底层图形库
options(shiny.usecairo = FALSE)
options(shiny.useragg = FALSE)

# =======================================================
# 1. 核心计算引擎 (保持不变)
# =======================================================
process_gene_logic <- function(df, target_gene, mode, trend_ctrl, paired_ctrl, paired_treat, top_n, k_reps) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL) 
  gene_data <- df %>% filter(Gene == target_gene)
  if (nrow(gene_data) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  if (mode == "trend" || mode == "grouped") {
    ctrl_name <- trend_ctrl
    all_groups <- unique(gene_data$Age)
  } else {
    ctrl_name <- paired_ctrl
    all_groups <- c(paired_ctrl, paired_treat)
    gene_data <- gene_data %>% filter(Age %in% all_groups)
  }
  
  ctrl_reps <- gene_data %>% filter(Age == ctrl_name) %>% pull(Bio_Rep) %>% unique()
  if(length(ctrl_reps) < k_reps) return(NULL) 
  
  ctrl_combos <- combn(ctrl_reps, k_reps, simplify = FALSE)
  all_scenarios_list <- list()
  
  for(d0_combo in ctrl_combos) {
    d0_base_df <- gene_data %>% filter(Age == ctrl_name, Bio_Rep %in% d0_combo) %>% distinct(Bio_Rep, Delta_Ct_Mean) %>% arrange(Bio_Rep)
    d0_ids <- d0_base_df$Bio_Rep
    d0_dCts <- d0_base_df$Delta_Ct_Mean
    
    current_scenario_data <- list(); current_scenario_score <- 0
    valid_scenario <- TRUE
    
    for(grp in all_groups) {
      age_df <- gene_data %>% filter(Age == grp)
      if(grp == ctrl_name) {
        res <- age_df %>% filter(Bio_Rep %in% d0_combo) %>% mutate(ddCt = Delta_Ct - Delta_Ct_Mean, RelExp_Hole = 2^(-ddCt)) %>%
          group_by(Bio_Rep) %>% mutate(Bio_RelExp = mean(RelExp_Hole)) %>% ungroup() %>%
          mutate(Pairing = paste0(Bio_Rep, " vs ", Bio_Rep)) %>% select(Gene, Age, Bio_Rep, Bio_RelExp, Pairing) %>% distinct()
        current_scenario_data[[grp]] <- res; current_scenario_score <- current_scenario_score + sd(res$Bio_RelExp)
      } else {
        reps_in_age <- unique(age_df$Bio_Rep)
        if(length(reps_in_age) >= k_reps) {
          ac_combos <- combn(reps_in_age, k_reps, simplify = FALSE)
          best_age_sd <- Inf; best_age_df <- NULL
          for(ac in ac_combos) {
            test_df <- age_df %>% filter(Bio_Rep %in% ac)
            exp_dCt_df <- test_df %>% distinct(Bio_Rep, Delta_Ct_Mean)
            p_dCts_list <- permn(exp_dCt_df$Delta_Ct_Mean); p_ids_list <- permn(exp_dCt_df$Bio_Rep)
            for(i in 1:length(p_dCts_list)) {
              rel_exps <- 2^-(p_dCts_list[[i]] - d0_dCts) 
              if(sd(rel_exps) < best_age_sd) {
                best_age_sd <- sd(rel_exps)
                best_age_df <- tibble(Gene = target_gene, Age = grp, Bio_Rep = p_ids_list[[i]], Bio_RelExp = rel_exps, Pairing = paste0(p_ids_list[[i]], " vs ", d0_ids))
              }
            }
          }
          current_scenario_data[[grp]] <- best_age_df; current_scenario_score <- current_scenario_score + best_age_sd
        } else {
          valid_scenario <- FALSE
        }
      }
    }
    if(valid_scenario) {
      scenario_key <- paste(d0_combo, collapse="_")
      all_scenarios_list[[scenario_key]] <- list(score = current_scenario_score, data = bind_rows(current_scenario_data))
    }
  }
  
  if(length(all_scenarios_list) == 0) return(NULL)
  sorted_idx <- order(sapply(all_scenarios_list, function(x) x$score))
  return(purrr::map_dfr(head(sorted_idx, top_n), function(idx) { 
    all_scenarios_list[[idx]]$data %>% mutate(Rank = which(sorted_idx == idx)) 
  }))
}

# =======================================================
# 1.5 计算引擎：严格配对 / 原始数据 (保持不变)
# =======================================================
calc_simple_logic <- function(df, target_gene, calc_type, mode, trend_ctrl, paired_ctrl, paired_treat) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL) 
  
  if (calc_type == "raw") {
    gene_data <- df %>% filter(Gene == target_gene)
  } else {
    gene_data <- df %>% filter(Gene == target_gene)
  }
  
  if (mode == "trend" || mode == "grouped") {
    ctrl_name <- trend_ctrl
    all_groups <- unique(gene_data$Age)
  } else {
    ctrl_name <- paired_ctrl
    all_groups <- c(paired_ctrl, paired_treat)
    gene_data <- gene_data %>% filter(Age %in% all_groups)
  }
  
  if (calc_type == "raw") {
    res <- gene_data %>%
      mutate(Rank = 0, Pairing = "Raw Data") %>%
      select(Gene, Age, Bio_Rep, Bio_RelExp, Rank, Pairing)
    return(res)
  }
  
  if (calc_type == "strict") {
    gene_data_collapsed <- gene_data %>% 
      distinct(Age, Bio_Rep, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    ctrl_df <- gene_data_collapsed %>% 
      filter(Age == ctrl_name) %>% 
      select(Bio_Rep, Ctrl_dCt = Delta_Ct_Mean)
    
    res_list <- list()
    for(grp in all_groups) {
      curr_df <- gene_data_collapsed %>% filter(Age == grp)
      joined <- inner_join(curr_df, ctrl_df, by = "Bio_Rep") %>%
        mutate(
          ddCt = Delta_Ct_Mean - Ctrl_dCt,
          Bio_RelExp = 2^(-ddCt),
          Rank = 0, 
          Pairing = paste0(Bio_Rep, " (Matched)")
        ) %>%
        select(Gene, Age, Bio_Rep, Bio_RelExp, Rank, Pairing)
      res_list[[grp]] <- joined
    }
    return(bind_rows(res_list))
  }
  return(NULL)
}

# =======================================================
# 3. Server 逻辑
# =======================================================
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  observe({
    lapply(greek_chars, function(char) {
      observeEvent(input[[paste0("btn_", char)]], {
        updateTextInput(session, "plot_title", value = paste0(input$plot_title, char))
      })
    })
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$calc_type, {
    if(input$calc_type == "raw") {
      updateTextInput(session, "ylab_text", value = "Value")
    } else {
      updateTextInput(session, "ylab_text", value = "Relative Expression")
    }
  })
  
  file_cols <- reactive({
    req(input$file)
    tryCatch({
      ext <- tools::file_ext(input$file$name)
      df <- if(ext == "csv") read.csv(input$file$datapath, check.names=F) else read_excel(input$file$datapath)
      colnames(df)
    }, error = function(e) return(NULL))
  })
  
  output$raw_col_selectors <- renderUI({
    req(file_cols())
    cols <- file_cols()
    tagList(
      selectInput("raw_gene_col", "名称/基因 (Gene)", choices = cols, selected = cols[1]),
      selectInput("raw_group_col", "分组 (Group)", choices = cols, selected = cols[2]),
      selectInput("raw_val_col", "数值 (Value)", choices = cols, selected = cols[3]),
      selectInput("raw_rep_col", "重复/ID (Rep) [可选]", choices = c("自动生成", cols), selected = "自动生成")
    )
  })
  
  data_prepared <- reactive({
    req(input$file)
    
    if(input$calc_type == "raw") {
      req(input$raw_gene_col, input$raw_group_col, input$raw_val_col)
      tryCatch({
        ext <- tools::file_ext(input$file$name)
        raw <- if(ext == "csv") read.csv(input$file$datapath, check.names=F) else read_excel(input$file$datapath)
        
        df <- raw %>%
          rename(Gene = !!input$raw_gene_col, 
                 Age = !!input$raw_group_col, 
                 Bio_RelExp = !!input$raw_val_col) %>%
          mutate(Gene = as.character(Gene), Age = as.character(Age), Bio_RelExp = as.numeric(Bio_RelExp)) %>%
          filter(!is.na(Bio_RelExp))
        
        if(input$raw_rep_col != "自动生成" && input$raw_rep_col %in% colnames(raw)) {
          df <- df %>% mutate(Bio_Rep = as.character(!!sym(input$raw_rep_col)))
        } else {
          df <- df %>% group_by(Gene, Age) %>% mutate(Bio_Rep = paste0("Rep", row_number())) %>% ungroup()
        }
        
        df <- df %>% mutate(Ct_Target=NA, Ct_Ref=NA, Delta_Ct=NA, Delta_Ct_Mean=NA)
        return(df)
        
      }, error = function(e) return(NULL))
    }
    
    tryCatch({
      ext <- tools::file_ext(input$file$name)
      raw_df <- if(ext == "csv") read.csv(input$file$datapath, check.names=F) else read_excel(input$file$datapath)
      cols <- colnames(raw_df)
      if (all(c("Gene", "Age", "Bio_Rep", "Ct_Target", "Ct_Ref") %in% cols)) {
        df <- raw_df %>% mutate(
          Ct_Target = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(Ct_Target))),
          Ct_Ref = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(Ct_Ref))),
          Age=as.character(Age), 
          Bio_Rep=as.character(Bio_Rep)
        )
      } else {
        find_col <- function(keys) { match <- cols[as.logical(rowSums(sapply(keys, function(k) grepl(k, cols, ignore.case=T))))]; return(match[1]) }
        col_s <- find_col(c("Sample", "Name")); col_t <- find_col(c("Target", "Gene")); col_c <- find_col(c("CT", "Ct"))
        df <- raw_df %>% select(SN=!!col_s, TN=!!col_t, CTV=!!col_c) %>%
          mutate(
            Ct_V = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(CTV))), 
            SN=str_trim(as.character(SN))
          ) %>%
          filter(!is.na(Ct_V)) %>% 
          mutate(Age = as.character(str_match(SN, "(.*?)(\\d+)$")[,2]), Bio_Rep = as.character(str_match(SN, "(.*?)(\\d+)$")[,3]),
                 Is_Ref = str_detect(TN, "-"), Gene = if_else(Is_Ref, str_remove(TN, ".*-"), TN)) %>%
          filter(!is.na(Age)) %>% group_by(Gene, Age, Bio_Rep, Is_Ref) %>% mutate(Tech_Idx = row_number()) %>% ungroup() %>%
          pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Gene, Age, Bio_Rep, Tech_Idx), names_from = Is_Ref, values_from = Ct_V) %>%
          rename(Ct_Target = `FALSE`, Ct_Ref = `TRUE`)
      }
      
      df %>% filter(!is.na(Ct_Target), !is.na(Ct_Ref)) %>% group_by(Gene, Age, Bio_Rep) %>%
        mutate(Ref_Mean = mean(Ct_Ref, na.rm = T)) %>% ungroup() %>%
        mutate(Delta_Ct = Ct_Target - Ref_Mean) %>% group_by(Gene, Age, Bio_Rep) %>%
        mutate(Delta_Ct_Mean = mean(Delta_Ct, na.rm = T)) %>% ungroup()
    }, error = function(e) return(NULL))
  })
  
  current_mapping <- reactive({
    req(data_prepared(), input$work_mode == "grouped")
    raw_groups <- sort(unique(data_prepared()$Age))
    do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(raw_groups), function(i) {
      nx <- input[[paste0("map_x_", i)]]; nl <- input[[paste0("map_leg_", i)]]
      if(is.null(nx) || is.null(nl)) return(NULL)
      data.frame(Age = raw_groups[i], New_X = nx, New_Leg = nl, stringsAsFactors = F)
    }))
  })
  
  output$group_mapping_ui <- renderUI({
    req(data_prepared())
    raw_groups <- sort(unique(data_prepared()$Age))
    tagList(lapply(seq_along(raw_groups), function(i) {
      grp <- raw_groups[i]
      parts <- strsplit(grp, "[_\\s]")[[1]]
      def_leg <- if(length(parts)>0) parts[1] else grp
      def_x <- if(length(parts)>1) paste(parts[-1], collapse="_") else grp
      div(class="map-row", span(class="map-label", paste("原始:", grp)),
          fluidRow(column(6, textInput(paste0("map_x_", i), "X轴", value = def_x)),
                   column(6, textInput(paste0("map_leg_", i), "图例", value = def_leg))))
    }))
  })
  
  output$group_ref_ui <- renderUI({
    req(input$map_leg_1); n_grps <- length(unique(data_prepared()$Age))
    curr_legs <- unique(sapply(1:n_grps, function(i) input[[paste0("map_leg_", i)]]))
    selectInput("group_ref_leg", "统计对照基准 (Legend)", choices = curr_legs)
  })
  
  output$mode_ui <- renderUI({
    req(data_prepared()); ages <- sort(unique(data_prepared()$Age))
    if (input$work_mode == "trend" || input$work_mode == "grouped") 
      textInput("ctrl_name", "归一化对照组 (原始名):", value = ages[1])
    else 
      tagList(selectInput("paired_ctrl", "对照组:", choices = ages), selectInput("paired_treat", "实验组:", choices = ages, selected = ages[2]))
  })
  
  results <- eventReactive(input$run, {
    req(data_prepared())
    k_val <- as.numeric(input$k_reps_input)
    df <- data_prepared()
    genes <- unique(df$Gene)
    
    withProgress(message = '正在执行计算...', value = 0, {
      all_res <- list()
      for(i in seq_along(genes)) {
        target_g <- genes[i]
        
        if(!is.null(input$work_mode) && input$work_mode == "grouped" && !is.null(input$norm_mode) && input$norm_mode == "within") {
          map_df <- current_mapping()
          if(!is.null(map_df)) {
            unique_xs <- unique(map_df$New_X)
            batch_res_list <- list()
            for(ux in unique_xs) {
              sub_map <- map_df %>% filter(New_X == ux)
              ctrl_age_row <- sub_map %>% filter(New_Leg == input$group_ref_leg)
              if(nrow(ctrl_age_row) == 1) {
                sub_ctrl <- ctrl_age_row$Age; sub_df <- df %>% filter(Age %in% sub_map$Age)
                
                if(input$calc_type == "opt") {
                  res <- process_gene_logic(sub_df, target_g, "trend", sub_ctrl, NULL, NULL, 1, k_val)
                  if(!is.null(res)) batch_res_list[[ux]] <- res %>% filter(Rank == 1)
                } else {
                  res <- calc_simple_logic(sub_df, target_g, input$calc_type, "trend", sub_ctrl, NULL, NULL)
                  if(!is.null(res)) batch_res_list[[ux]] <- res
                }
              }
            }
            if(length(batch_res_list) > 0) all_res[[target_g]] <- bind_rows(batch_res_list) %>% mutate(Rank = 1)
          }
        } else {
          if(input$calc_type == "opt") {
            res <- process_gene_logic(df, target_g, input$work_mode, input$ctrl_name, input$paired_ctrl, input$paired_treat, 12, k_val)
          } else {
            res <- calc_simple_logic(df, target_g, input$calc_type, input$work_mode, input$ctrl_name, input$paired_ctrl, input$paired_treat)
          }
          if(!is.null(res)) all_res[[target_g]] <- res
        }
        setProgress(i/length(genes))
      }
      all_res
    })
  })
  
  output$gene_selector <- renderUI({ req(results()); selectInput("selected_gene", "分析基因:", choices = names(results())) })
  observeEvent(input$selected_gene, { updateTextInput(session, "plot_title", value = input$selected_gene) })
  
  # =======================================================
  # 绘图逻辑 (修复散点 & 误差棒粗细 & WebR 字体 Bug)
  # =======================================================
  plot_engine <- function(data, is_main = TRUE) {
    req(data, nrow(data) > 0)
    req(input$work_mode, input$calc_type) 
    
    plot_type_val <- if(!is.null(input$plot_type)) input$plot_type else "bar"
    
    eb_width <- if(!is.null(input$errorbar_width)) input$errorbar_width else 0.12
    eb_lwd <- if(!is.null(input$errorbar_lwd)) input$errorbar_lwd else 0.8
    
    jit_width <- if(!is.null(input$jitter_width)) input$jitter_width else 0.08
    p_fill_col <- if(!is.null(input$point_fill_col) && input$point_fill_col != "") input$point_fill_col else "white"
    x_angle <- if(!is.null(input$x_angle)) input$x_angle else 0
    x_hjust <- if(x_angle > 0) 1 else 0.5
    
    sig_offset <- if(!is.null(input$sig_y_offset)) input$sig_y_offset else 0.05
    sig_tip <- if(!is.null(input$sig_tip_len)) input$sig_tip_len else 0.02
    leg_key_size <- if(!is.null(input$legend_key_size)) input$legend_key_size else 0.6
    
    # 【修改点】默认为 plain 防止 WebR 报错
    leg_face <- if(!is.null(input$legend_face)) input$legend_face else "plain"
    
    if(isTRUE(input$use_custom_cols)) {
      final_cols <- str_trim(unlist(strsplit(input$custom_cols, ",")))
    } else {
      palette_list <- list(npg=c("#E64B35","#4DBBD5","#00A087","#3C5488"), aaas=c("#3B4992","#EE0000","#008B45","#631879"), 
                           lancet=c("#00468B","#ED0000","#42B540","#0099B4"), nejm=c("#BC3C29","#0072B5","#E18727","#20854E"), 
                           jama=c("#374E55","#DF8F44","#00A1D5","#B24745"), jco=c("#0073C2","#EFC000","#868686","#CD534C"), 
                           d3=c("#1F77B4","#FF7F0E","#2CA02C","#D62728"), igv=c("#5050FF","#FF5050","#00BD00","#FFB900"))
      final_cols <- palette_list[[input$palette]]
    }
    
    show_leg <- isTRUE(input$show_legend)
    leg_pos_val <- if(show_leg) {
      if(!is.null(input$legend_pos) && input$legend_pos == "custom") c(input$leg_x, input$leg_y) else input$legend_pos
    } else "none"
    leg_title_txt <- if(!is.null(input$legend_title)) input$legend_title else "Condition"
    
    use_expand <- isTRUE(input$y_expand)
    top_gap_mult <- if(!is.null(input$y_top_gap)) input$y_top_gap else 0.15
    y_expand_vec <- if(use_expand) c(0, 0) else expansion(mult = c(0.05, top_gap_mult))
    
    # === Grouped Mode ===
    if (input$work_mode == "grouped") {
      map_df <- current_mapping()
      if(is.null(map_df)) return(NULL)
      plot_data <- data %>% left_join(map_df, by="Age")
      uniq_x <- unique(map_df$New_X); plot_data$New_X <- factor(plot_data$New_X, levels = uniq_x)
      
      if(!is.null(input$group_ref_leg) && input$group_ref_leg %in% plot_data$New_Leg) {
        lvls <- c(input$group_ref_leg, setdiff(unique(plot_data$New_Leg), input$group_ref_leg))
        plot_data$New_Leg <- factor(plot_data$New_Leg, levels = lvls)
      } else {
        plot_data$New_Leg <- factor(plot_data$New_Leg)
      }
      
      stats <- plot_data %>% group_by(New_X, New_Leg) %>% summarise(M=mean(Bio_RelExp), S=sd(Bio_RelExp), Max=max(Bio_RelExp), .groups="drop")
      max_val <- max(stats$M + stats$S, stats$Max, na.rm=T)
      y_limit_top <- max_val * (1 + top_gap_mult)
      dodge_w <- if(!is.null(input$dodge_width)) input$dodge_width else 0.8
      
      p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x=New_X, y=Bio_RelExp, fill=New_Leg))
      
      if(plot_type_val == "box") {
        p <- p + geom_boxplot(position=position_dodge(width=dodge_w), width=input$bar_width, color="black", linewidth=input$bar_lwd, outlier.shape = NA)
      } else if(plot_type_val == "violin") {
        p <- p + geom_violin(position=position_dodge(width=dodge_w), width=input$bar_width, color="black", linewidth=input$bar_lwd, trim = FALSE)
      } else {
        p <- ggplot(stats, aes(x=New_X, y=M, fill=New_Leg)) + 
          geom_bar(stat="identity", position=position_dodge(width=dodge_w), width=input$bar_width, color="black", linewidth=input$bar_lwd) +
          geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=M, ymax=M+S), position=position_dodge(width=dodge_w), width=eb_width, linewidth=eb_lwd)
      }
      
      # 【修改点】强制覆盖 theme_prism 默认的粗体(bold)行为为 plain
      p <- p + theme_prism(base_fontface = "plain") + scale_fill_manual(values = rep(final_cols, length.out=20), name=leg_title_txt)
      
      if(isTRUE(input$show_points)) {
        pt_data <- if(plot_type_val == "bar") plot_data else plot_data
        p <- p + geom_point(data=pt_data, 
                            # 【核心修复1】将 group=New_Leg 替换为 color=New_Leg，喂给 jitterdodge 需要的映射
                            aes(x=New_X, y=Bio_RelExp, color=New_Leg), 
                            fill=p_fill_col,
                            position=position_jitterdodge(jitter.width=jit_width, dodge.width=dodge_w), 
                            shape=input$point_shape, 
                            # 【核心修复2】去掉了这里的 color="black"
                            size=input$point_size, 
                            stroke=input$point_stroke_wide, alpha=input$point_alpha, show.legend = FALSE) +
          # 【核心修复3】强制将所有映射出的颜色变回黑色，隐藏图例，完美还原原始UI效果！
          scale_color_manual(values = rep("black", 100), guide = "none")
      }
      
      if(is_main && !is.null(input$group_ref_leg) && input$calc_type != "raw") {
        num_levels <- length(unique(plot_data$New_Leg))
        if(num_levels > 2) {
          try({
            letter_df <- plot_data %>% group_by(New_X) %>% do({
              sub_d <- .
              if(length(unique(sub_d$New_Leg)) > 1 && var(sub_d$Bio_RelExp) > 1e-6) {
                mod <- lm(Bio_RelExp ~ New_Leg, data = sub_d)
                res_hsd <- HSD.test(mod, "New_Leg", group = TRUE)
                df_l <- res_hsd$groups %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("New_Leg") %>% select(New_Leg, groups)
              } else { df_l <- data.frame(New_Leg = unique(sub_d$New_Leg), groups = "") }
              df_l
            }) %>% ungroup()
            label_data <- stats %>% left_join(letter_df, by=c("New_X", "New_Leg"))
            y_offset <- if(plot_type_val == "bar") (stats$M + stats$S) else stats$Max
            label_data$Y_Pos <- y_offset + (max_val * sig_offset)
            
            # 【修改点】将字体强制改为 plain
            p <- p + geom_text(data = label_data, aes(x=New_X, y=Y_Pos, label=groups, group=New_Leg),
                               position = position_dodge(width=dodge_w),
                               size=input$sig_size, fontface="plain", vjust = 0, family = input$font_family, color="black")
          }, silent=FALSE)
        } else {
          try({
            stat_test <- plot_data %>% group_by(New_X) %>% t_test(Bio_RelExp ~ New_Leg, ref.group = input$group_ref_leg) %>%
              adjust_pvalue(method = "none") %>% add_significance("p") %>% add_xy_position(x = "New_X", dodge = dodge_w)
            base_y <- if(plot_type_val == "bar") max(stats$M + stats$S, na.rm=T) else max(stats$Max, na.rm=T)
            stat_test$y.position <- base_y + (max_val * sig_offset)
            p <- p + stat_pvalue_manual(stat_test, label = "p.signif", tip.length = sig_tip,
                                        bracket.nudge.y = 0, hide.ns = TRUE, size = input$sig_size, bracket.size = input$sig_lwd)
          }, silent=TRUE)
        }
      }
      
    } else {
      # === Trend / Paired Mode ===
      ctrl <- if(input$work_mode == "trend") input$ctrl_name else input$paired_ctrl
      if (is.null(ctrl) || !(ctrl %in% data$Age)) ctrl <- data$Age[1]
      levels_order <- c(ctrl, setdiff(unique(data$Age), ctrl))
      plot_data <- data %>% mutate(Age = factor(Age, levels = levels_order))
      
      stats <- plot_data %>% group_by(Age) %>% summarise(M=mean(Bio_RelExp), S=sd(Bio_RelExp), Max=max(Bio_RelExp), .groups="drop")
      max_val <- max(stats$M + stats$S, stats$Max, na.rm=T)
      y_limit_top <- max_val * (1 + top_gap_mult)
      
      p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x=Age, y=Bio_RelExp, fill=Age))
      
      if(plot_type_val == "box") {
        p <- p + geom_boxplot(width=input$bar_width, color="black", linewidth=input$bar_lwd, outlier.shape = NA)
      } else if(plot_type_val == "violin") {
        p <- p + geom_violin(width=input$bar_width, color="black", linewidth=input$bar_lwd, trim = FALSE)
      } else {
        p <- ggplot(stats, aes(x=Age, y=M)) +
          geom_bar(aes(fill=Age), stat="identity", width=input$bar_width, color="black", linewidth=input$bar_lwd) + 
          geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=M, ymax=M+S), width=eb_width, linewidth=eb_lwd)
      }
      
      # 【修改点】强制覆盖 theme_prism 默认的粗体(bold)行为为 plain
      p <- p + theme_prism(base_fontface = "plain") + scale_fill_manual(values = rep(final_cols, length.out=20), name=leg_title_txt)
      
      if(isTRUE(input$show_points)) {
        pt_data <- if(plot_type_val == "bar") plot_data else plot_data
        p <- p + geom_point(data=pt_data, aes(x=Age, y=Bio_RelExp), 
                            fill=p_fill_col, 
                            shape=input$point_shape, color="black", size=input$point_size, stroke=input$point_stroke_wide, 
                            alpha=input$point_alpha, position = position_jitter(width=jit_width, seed=1), show.legend = FALSE)
      }
      
      if(is_main && !is.null(input$calc_type) && input$calc_type != "raw") {
        try({
          y_base <- if(plot_type_val == "bar") (stats$M + stats$S) else stats$Max
          if(length(levels_order) > 2) {
            fit <- lm(Bio_RelExp ~ factor(Age, levels=levels_order), data = data)
            hsd <- HSD.test(fit, "factor(Age, levels = levels_order)", group = TRUE)
            ldf <- as.data.frame(hsd$groups) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("Age")
            
            # 【修改点】将字体强制改为 plain
            p <- p + geom_text(data = stats %>% left_join(ldf, by="Age"), 
                               aes(label=groups, y=y_base + (max_val * sig_offset)), 
                               size=input$sig_size, fontface="plain", vjust = 0, family = input$font_family, color="black")
          } else {
            test_res <- data %>% t_test(Bio_RelExp ~ Age) %>% add_significance() %>% add_xy_position(x="Age")
            test_res$y.position <- max(y_base) + (max_val * sig_offset)
            p <- p + stat_pvalue_manual(test_res, label = "p.signif", size = input$sig_size, bracket.size = input$sig_lwd, tip.length = sig_tip)
          }
        }, silent = TRUE)
      }
    }
    
    p <- p + theme(
      plot.margin = if(is_main) margin(10, 10, 10, 10) else margin(2, 2, 2, 2),
      text = element_text(family = input$font_family),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = input$title_hjust, vjust = input$title_vjust, size = if(is_main) input$title_size else 10, face = input$title_style),
      axis.title.x = if(is_main) element_text(size = input$xtitle_size) else element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = if(is_main) element_text(size = input$ytitle_size) else element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = if(is_main) input$xtext_size else 8, color = "black", angle = x_angle, hjust = x_hjust),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = if(is_main) input$ytext_size else 8, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = input$axis_lwd),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = input$axis_lwd),
      legend.position = if(is_main) leg_pos_val else "none",
      legend.title = element_text(size = if(!is.null(input$legend_text_size)) input$legend_text_size else 10, face = leg_face),
      legend.text = element_text(size = if(!is.null(input$legend_text_size)) input$legend_text_size else 10, face = leg_face),
      legend.key.size = unit(leg_key_size, "cm"),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill="transparent", color=NA)
    ) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = y_expand_vec, limits = c(0, y_limit_top)) +
      labs(x = input$xlab_text, y = input$ylab_text, title = if(is_main) input$plot_title else NULL)
    
    return(p)
  }
  
  output$main_plot <- renderPlot({
    req(input$selected_gene, results())
    dat <- results()[[input$selected_gene]]
    if(input$calc_type == "opt" && !(input$norm_mode == "within" && !is.null(input$work_mode) && input$work_mode == "grouped")) {
      dat <- dat %>% filter(Rank == 1)
    }
    plot_engine(dat)
  }, width = function() input$num_w * 85, height = function() input$num_h * 85)
  
  output$preview_plot <- renderPlot({
    req(input$selected_gene, results())
    if(input$calc_type != "opt") return(NULL)
    if(input$norm_mode == "within" && !is.null(input$work_mode) && input$work_mode == "grouped") return(NULL)
    
    all_ranks <- results()[[input$selected_gene]]
    p_list <- lapply(sort(unique(all_ranks$Rank)), function(r) { 
      plot_engine(all_ranks %>% filter(Rank == r), is_main = FALSE) + labs(title=paste("Rank", r)) 
    })
    wrap_plots(p_list, ncol=4) & theme(plot.margin = margin(2,2,2,2))
  })
  
  output$rank1_detail_table <- renderDT({ 
    req(results()); dat <- results()[[input$selected_gene]]
    if(input$calc_type == "opt" && !(input$norm_mode == "within" && !is.null(input$work_mode) && input$work_mode == "grouped")) dat <- dat %>% filter(Rank == 1)
    datatable(dat, options = list(scrollX = T)) 
  })
  
  output$raw_table <- renderDT({ datatable(data_prepared(), options = list(scrollX = T)) })
  
  # 【修改点】PDF 替换为 PNG 下载 (600 DPI)
  output$download_png <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() { paste0(input$selected_gene, "_", Sys.Date(), ".png") },
    content = function(file) { 
      dat <- results()[[input$selected_gene]]
      if(input$calc_type == "opt" && !(input$norm_mode == "within" && !is.null(input$work_mode) && input$work_mode == "grouped")) dat <- dat %>% filter(Rank == 1)
      ggsave(file, plot = plot_engine(dat), width = input$num_w, height = input$num_h, device = "png", dpi = 600, bg = "white") 
    }
  )
  
  # 【修改点】清理 SVG 报错相关的 device 配置
  output$download_svg <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() { paste0(input$selected_gene, "_", Sys.Date(), ".svg") },
    content = function(file) { 
      dat <- results()[[input$selected_gene]]
      if(input$calc_type == "opt" && !(input$norm_mode == "within" && !is.null(input$work_mode) && input$work_mode == "grouped")) dat <- dat %>% filter(Rank == 1)
      ggsave(file, plot = plot_engine(dat), width = input$num_w, height = input$num_h, device = "svg", bg = "white") 
    }
  )
}
